description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: Verified 2026-08-13: npm run dev completed check/build and Electron remained running until intentionally terminated; BrowserWindow is configured at 1200x800 with contextIsolation=true, nodeIntegration=false, and the typed preload script.

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: DocumentList renders the empty-library guidance and imported document cards with filename type, size, indexing status, selection, detail display, and delete controls; npm run check and production build pass.

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: QuestionPanel submits through window.knowledgeBase.qa.ask on Enter or click; QaService test verifies grounded 0.85-confidence response, citation, and persisted history.

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: PersistenceService constructor initializes knowledge-base-data with content, chunks, and index subdirectories; service tests create, use, and clean an isolated data directory successfully.
